rules.name: radius-always-zero
rules.summary: Corner radius is always 0 — square form is the system's language.
rules.why: The source system is rectilinear; no rounded form appears in any application (docs/portability/02-derived-system.md, §F1).
rules.fix: Remove border-radius or set it to 0 on the offending element.

rules.name: accent-not-a-surface
rules.summary: The accent red is never a reading surface and never carries meaning alone.
rules.why: Source color rules restrict red to identification and actions on paper; never behind reading text (manual p8).
rules.fix: Move content off the accent surface; use ink on paper for reading text.

rules.name: no-elevation
rules.summary: No drop shadows or elevation; hierarchy uses rules, bands, and inversion.
rules.why: Print-derived system with no elevation concept (§F3).
rules.fix: Replace box-shadow with a 1px border or a rule.

rules.name: status-needs-text
rules.summary: Status must include a text label; the square marker never carries meaning alone.
rules.fix: Add the status word next to the marker.
